content_of_post_to_comment: The more you deviate from the monoculture’s norm, the more the system will try to correct you. This is the system maintaining its order. And it uses shame as one of its most effective tools to flatten diversity. It feels like your shame, which is why you carry it and let it weigh you down. But it isn’t yours at all. It’s the system’s own unprocessed fear and envy which it can’t face in itself. It gets given to you as shame, and shame’s whole job is to make you shrink until you’re small enough for the system’s comfort.
